name: gizza-ai/csv-to-xlsx
summary: Convert CSV or JSON table data into a real Excel .xlsx workbook

tool.description: Convert a table (CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-delimited, a JSON array of objects/rows, or NDJSON) into a real binary Excel .xlsx workbook and return it as a download. Numbers and booleans are written as native Excel cell types (leading-zero values like 007 stay text); the first row can be a bold, frozen header, and columns are auto-sized.

autofit.description: Auto-size each column's width to fit its content (default true).

data.description: The table as text: CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-delimited, a JSON array of objects/rows, or NDJSON. Example: `name,age\nAlice,30`.

detect_types.description: Detect numbers and booleans in delimited cells and write them as native Excel types (default true); off writes every delimited cell as text. Leading-zero values like 007 always stay text. JSON/NDJSON keep their own types.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header (default true): its cells become a bold, frozen top row, and for JSON objects the keys are the header. Off writes data with no header row.

input_format.description: Source format. 'auto' (default) sniffs CSV/TSV/semicolon/pipe/JSON/NDJSON from the text; set it explicitly to override the guess.

sheet_name.description: Worksheet tab name (default 'Sheet1'). Excel limits apply: at most 31 characters, and the characters []:*?/\ are replaced with '_'.
